warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.listLimitationNote: The Inventory service has no warehouse list endpoint — this shows warehouses created from this browser. Use "Open by ID" to view any other warehouse.
warehouses.emptyDescription: Create one, or open an existing warehouse by ID.
warehouses.updateNotAvailable: Not available — the backend doesn't support updating warehouses yet.
warehouses.deleteNotAvailable: Not available — the backend doesn't support deleting warehouses yet.

detail.stockScopeNote: Scoped to inventory records known to this browser — see docs/modules/inventory-management.md.
detail.noLocalStock: No locally-known stock records for this warehouse yet.

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: Look up real-time stock for a product, or browse inventory records known to this browser.

lookup.title: Stock lookup
lookup.rollupNote: Rolled up across every warehouse (or narrowed to the selected variation) — the backend doesn't expose a per-warehouse breakdown.

records.title: Inventory records
records.limitationNote: No inventory list endpoint exists — this shows records known to this browser (opened by ID, or acted on via stock-in/out/adjust).
records.searchPlaceholder: Search by id, product, or variation...
records.emptyDescription: Open one by ID to get started.

actions.transferNotAvailable: Not available — the backend has no stock transfer endpoint yet.

transactions.title: Stock Transactions
transactions.description: Aggregated transaction history across every inventory record known to this browser.
transactions.emptyDescription: Transactions appear here once a stock-in/out/adjust action is recorded on a known inventory record.
